messages:
alex_infra: heads-up — planning a rolling maintenance for GPU nodes in us-west-2 tomorrow 02:00-05:00 PT. Reboots + driver patch. Affects G4/G5 pools. Need to drain nodes to avoid evicting long running jobs.

maya_sre: what's the expected QPS impact? do we have capacity to absorb 30% node drain?

sam_platform: we ran simulation — with autoscale and burst capacity we can keep latency SLO for short bursts, but embeddings throughput will degrade ~15% in peak windows. Recommend staging drains by AZ and leaving at least 1 p100 pool online.

jin_ops: proposed sequence:
1) cordon + drain one node at a time in az-a
2) perform reboot + install nvidia-driver-525
3) uncordon and verify kubelet + GPU exporter
4) move to az-b

Command:
```
kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
ssh node && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-525
```

deploy-bot: scheduled window created: 2024-04-15T02:00:00-07:00 -> 2024-04-15T05:00:00-07:00. Change request CR-1124.

maya_sre: please add runbook link and escalation matrix. who'll be on call during window?

alex_infra: I'll be primary, @maya_sre backup, @sam_platform will watch metrics. runbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/CR-1124. FYI customers in eu-west won't be impacted but ap-south may see routing to other regions.

jin_ops: cost note: we'll spill ~200 GPU-hours to on-demand burst — approx $3.2k for the window. Should we bill to infra vs product? cc: @finance

sam_platform: suggest using reserved pool credits we have for infra. If not, product cost center agreed previously. tag cost: infra/maintenance.

maya_sre: notify customers? recommend a short banner >24h prior and a follow-up after. I'll draft the banner.

alex_infra: cool. action items:
- [ ] maya: customer banner + status page
- [ ] jin: node patch script and smoke tests
- [ ] sam: capacity simulation + rollback plan
- [ ] alex: runbook + Slack incident channel

maya_sre: ack. Will post banner at +24h and create #incident-CR-1124 at start.

sam_platform: one more: monitor GPU temp + ECC errors during first hour; set alert threshold to 2 occurrences -> page SRE.

alex_infra: noted. low-risk but coordinated. any objections? :eyes:

jin_ops: none from infra side. :thumbsup:

maya_sre: no objections.

deploy-bot: CR-1124 marked as scheduled by alex_infra.
